title: Ring of Colour Spray

sources.title: Colour Spray (condition)
markers: Range of attacks and spells reduced

summary: Casts Colour Spray once per Short Rest.

fields.Colour Spray: Level 1, Action, 17 ft cone. Affects creatures up to a combined 33 current HP, with no saving throw. For 1 turn affected creatures have disadvantage on attacks, normal attack and spell range capped at 10 ft, and attackers have advantage against them.
fields.Acquisition: Harpy Nest south of the harpy encounter.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
